# schema stamped by need, not by tool version

Review 0.4.9 #4: 0.4.0-0.4.8 added isolated/planned/test_kinds/scope_signature without a schema bump, so an older harna loaded them, ignored them (no deny_unknown_fields) and stripped them on its next save. Options: (a) bump SCHEMA_VERSION to 2 for every file — forces every repo to migrate and makes all data unreadable to older teammates even when it uses nothing new; (b) deny_unknown_fields — breaks forward reading of any additive field; (c) stamp each file with the lowest version that holds it. Chose (c): SCHEMA_VERSION=2 is what this harna understands, SCHEMA_BASELINE=1 is the stamp when nothing newer is used; save_manifest/save_rules compute required_schema(); migrate targets the needed version; doctor warns only when a file uses newer fields under an older stamp. Other registers stay at the baseline (no new fields). Next additive field that an older harna would drop raises required_schema the same way.
